page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a bracketed block of Pluperfect forms in the middle-lower area; page number top right. No margin notes.

main_text.p:
Noi perdemo, wir verlieren.
Voi perdete, jhr verlieret.
Coloro perdono, sie verlieren.
main_text.head: Praeterit. Imperfect.
main_text.p:
Io perdena, ich verlohr, verluhr.
Tu perdeui, du verluhrst.
Colui perdena, er verlohr, verluhr.
Noi perdenamo, wir verluhren.
Voi perdenate, jhr verluhret.
Coloro perdeuano, sie verluhren.
main_text.head: Praeterit perfect. duplicatum.
main_text.p:
Io perdei & pe[?] etti, ho perduto, ich hab verloren.
Tu perdesti & hai perduto, & perso, du hast verloren.
Colui perdette, & ha perduto, er hat verlohren.
Noi perdemmo, & habbiamo perduto, wir haben verlohren.
Voi perdeste, & hauete perduto, jhr habt verloren.
Coloro perdettero & hanno perduto, sie haben verlorn.
main_text.head: Plusquamperfect.
main_text.p: Io haueua, Ich hatte, Tu haueui, du hattest, Colui haueua, er hatte, Noi hauenamo, wir hatten, Voi hauenate, jhr hattet, Coloro hauenano, sie hatten. verloren.

page.notes: Pluperfect block is set with a bracket; the bracket and the word "verloren" beside it are printed at the right. Several words in the Praeterit perfect line are damaged and uncertain (marked by [?]). Page bottom shows a catchword "Futu" partly cut off.
